text:
Type: pink two-drawer kids chest
Use: storing children's clothes and toys; children's room, nursery
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: painted fiberboard in a smooth matte finish
Colors: light pastel pink, dark grey grip holes
Shape: two deep drawers with large round cut-out grips, rounded top corners and soft edges, sides that extend into short curved legs, playful and compact
Feel: sweet, soft, playful, cheerful
Goes with: white walls, pale wood, pastel textiles; Scandinavian or modern children's rooms
